units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 12:14">Targ. Y. Num. XII, 14</cite> (h. text <he>הכלם</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Arakhin 16b:49">Arakh. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>דלִיכְסוֹף זרעיה וכ׳</he> that the seed of Rab should be put to shame through me.

Taan. 22ᵃ וכְסִיפָא להו מילתא וכ׳ Ms. M. 2 a. Rashi (Ms. M. 1 only וכסיפא להו, ed. ואִכְּסִיפוּ Ithpe.) and the gentlemen (you) felt abashed to tell us; a. fr.—[Targ. Ps. XLI, 7 יכסף some ed., read: יכנף, v. כְּנַף I.]
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 44:10">Targ. Ps. XLIV, 10</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:12">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>כַּסִּיפְתִּינָן</he> (<he>כַּסַּפְ׳</he>) thou didst frighten us (by a false alarm).
<cite ref="Chagigah 5a:12">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>וכַסַּפְתֵּיה</he> and thou didst put him to shame; Koh. R. end <he>וכַסִּיפְתֵּיה</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 3b:1">Sabb. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>דאי לאו … כספתיה וכ׳</he> for if he were not a great man, thou mightst have put him to shame, for he might have given thee an inappropriate reply.
<cite ref="Horayot 13b">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>מַכְסְפִיתוּ לי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>כסיפיתנן</he>, corr. <he>כַּסִּיפְתּוּנָן</he>) you might have put me to shame; a. e.

senses.gloss: to reduce in value, to cause deterioration.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 104b:17">Keth. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>מְכַסְּפֵי</he> (or <he>מַכְסְפֵי</he>) they (the heirs) will neglect it (instead of improving).—[
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 74:21">Targ. Ps. LXXIV, 21</cite> <he>מַכְסִיף</he> (prob. to be read: <he>מַכְסַף</he> or <he>מְכַסַּף</he>, part. pass.).]

senses.gloss: to be made pale, to be frightened, to be put to shame.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 6:20">Targ. Job VI, 20</cite>; a. e.—Kidd. l. c. <he>מוטב תִּיכַּסְּפוּ … ולא תיכספו מיני וכ׳</he> it is better that you of the house of Amram be frightened through me in this world, than that you should be ashamed of me (as a sinner) in the world to come.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 111a">B. Bath. 111ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 36a:5">Ab. Zar. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>איכ׳</he> he felt alarmed.
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:1">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיכַּסְּפָא ועיילא וכ׳</he> (missing in Ms. M.) she felt abashed and went &c.; a. fr.
